content.title: Oklo Upgraded Days After This Cathie Wood Buy Amid Meta Deal Excitement
content.summary: Nuclear startup Oklo was handed a bullish upgrade before Wednesday's stock market open based on a previously announced binding agreement with Facebook-parent Meta Platforms  to develop a 1.2 gigawatt advanced nuclear campus.  Bank of America analysts on Wednesday upgraded Oklo to buy from neutral with a price target of 127, up from 111.  The analysts decided to upgrade Oklo after the advanced nuclear technology company on Jan. 9 announced a deal with Meta that "advances" its development of a 1.2 gigawatt campus in Pike County, Ohio.
